SIX-BOX: (1)PRIOR: DEEP full DC is the winning lever. iter-4 (n_cg5,relax0.5,init_t0.05) was rmse0.00669 hr=0; iter-5 (n_cg30,relax1.0) dropped rmse to 0.004924 -> FIRST hr>0. The deep CG solves the 128-view least-squares more accurately than the analytic Hann FBP, beating baseline. (2)FAILURE: n_cg30 may still under-converge the CG; more iters could lower rmse further. (3)ONE KNOB: dc_n_cg 30->60 (2x deeper, extend the winning direction; relax1.0/init_t0.05/steps8/eta1.0 held). (4)HYPOTHESIS: 60 CG iters drive the recon closer to the exact data-consistent LS solution, lifting hr above 0.0557; if it converges (hr plateaus), that is the DC-limit hr for this prior. (5)BUDGET: 60 CG x 8 steps x 200 slices; iter-5 (30CG) took ~5.5min, 60CG ~ up to ~11min, inside the 20-min HARD budget. (6)Serial.
